name: Shadps4
tagline: An early PlayStation 4 emulator for Windows, Linux and macOS written in C++.
description: shadPS4 is an early PlayStation 4 emulator for Windows, Linux and macOS written in C++.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/shadps4:version-shadPS4QtLauncher-2026-09-12-864dc30bc5372d7ad95ef609188942ecd77bf6f4@sha256:c15058c8d9ce5b5a0e1cd0b570296b3696f85d5e92274e9a0ef1e4da369b0560
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
